mapper.insert: insert into ssm_dataset ( dataset_id, dataset_name, rpt_dev_owner, data_dev_owner, data_date, data_desc, is_standard_dataset, dataset_type, sort_id, is_active, created_time, created_by ) values ( #{datasetId}, #{datasetName}, #{rptDevOwner}, #{dataDevOwner}, #{dataDate}, #{dataDesc}, #{isStandardDataset}, #{datasetType}, #{sortId}, #{isActive}, now(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update ssm_dataset set dataset_name = #{datasetName}, rpt_dev_owner = #{rptDevOwner}, data_dev_owner = #{dataDevOwner}, data_date = #{dataDate}, data_desc = #{dataDesc}, sort_id = #{sortId}, updated_time = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, is_active = #{isActive}, is_standard_dataset = #{isStandardDataset}, dataset_type = #{datasetType} where dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.select: select dataset_id as datasetId, dataset_name as datasetName, rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner, data_date as dataDate, data_desc as dataDesc, sort_id as sortId, is_active as isActive, is_standard_dataset as isStandardDataset, dataset_type as datasetType from ssm_dataset where dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.insert: insert into ssm_dataset_ctg_rel ( rel_id, ctg_id, dataset_id ) values ( #{relId}, #{ctgId}, #{datasetId} )
mapper.select: SELECT dataset_id as datasetId, dataset_name as datasetName, rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner, data_date as dataDate, data_desc as dataDesc, sort_id as sortId, is_active as isActive, is_standard_dataset as isStandardDataset, dataset_type as datasetType FROM ssm_dataset WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_id
